scope_note: OK means logical U2 contribution designed, not implemented or verified. All 62 assigned functional rows and ten NFRs are checked against current source assignments. Lead requirements need full U2 implementation plus named consumer integration; contributor rows retain their other unit lead.

contributions.acceptance: Find/refine parity: complete query, lexical/semantic, filtering, ordering, pagination and recovery outcomes; U1 proves its selected real journey path.
Preserve every retained query/refinement/order/rerun behavior and stable paper/version identity; U1 implements the demonstrated query/open path.
Verify lexical and semantic relevance plus explicit supported degradation; U1's actual demonstration mode and fallback cannot stand for all modes.
Distinguish invalid/loading/empty/partial/error and stable-window changes; verify input boundaries, retry context and pagination across the full search surface.
Authorize private documents, figures and downloads by owner/context; reject cross-user, anonymous, revoked, traversal and public-route resolution attempts.
Complete every retained assistance operation/level/language with recoverable acceptance, progress and prepared-result reads; U1 implements a real bounded understanding path.
Verify the complete summary/translation/presentation-choice set and usable source-bound output, including ineligible input and unavailable-model outcomes.
Verify recoverable durable acceptance/dispatch, duplicate and lost-response reconciliation, worker restart and single accounting effects through real execution.
Complete owner glossary inspection/update/use with normalization, failures and concurrent edits; retain one glossary owner in PaperAssistance.
Persist and reopen owner terminology; prove relevant eligible output uses the acknowledged preference and deny another user's reads/writes.
Verify empty/duplicate/Unicode/conflicting/oversized inputs, failed writes, repeated submissions and visible concurrent-update resolution.
Complete saved papers/searches and history; U1 proves selected durable save/revisit paths, while U3 supplies changed-source/canonical dispositions.
Verify add/list/remove for all retained saved paper/query behavior, stable identity, duplicate requests, failed persistence and later authenticated return.
Verify recorded query/refinement history, pagination, rerun and owner-only clear; delayed completion facts must not defeat a clear boundary.
Verify unavailable/withdrawn/canonicalized sources preserve truthful saved references; check cross-owner denial and convergence between tabs.
Complete public account lifecycle and abuse/session protection; U1 supplies the necessary real account boundary for its journey, not all lifecycle parity.
Verify registration, email verification, login/logout, duplicates, expired/replayed links and failed delivery; distinguish local test delivery from the public normal path.
Verify password reset/change and email change, identity checks, interruption, token replay and documented credential/session revocation without losing committed work.
Complete withdrawal/reactivation only under approved data policy; AccountAccess tracks required domain acknowledgements, pending-work and backup/restore dispositions.
Verify server validation, abuse bounds, forged/replayed identity/session requests and logout/revocation across protected entrypoints.
Complete retained external identity/profile behavior and administrator MFA boundaries; do not infer PlatformControl authority from an application role.
Verify Google/ORCID sign-in/link/profile and retained unlink behavior, collisions, denied consent, callback replay and provider failure.
Verify ordinary-user denial, current administrator MFA, replay/expiry and the controlled recovery procedure; no production bypass.
Complete durable profile/consent controls and truthful existing mock/administrative plan presentation; verify processing consequences in consuming domains.
Verify owner-isolated profile/consent updates, failed writes and governed future processing, including queued effects rechecking current permission.
Present configured mock/administrative subscription state truthfully; never claim real charges, purchased entitlement or billing parity.
Complete bounded cited/citing exploration and eligible saves; Discovery owns relationships and Library owns the saved reference.
Verify cited/citing identity, traversal/duplicate bounds and eligible reference saves through the real library operation.
Verify provider limits, incomplete/unknown/stale/unavailable citation data, freshness and recovery without fabricating edges or losing saved references.
Complete explicit defaults, recent-paper views and controlled behavior/profile processing; U1 implements only defaults needed by its journey.
Verify persistence and subsequent use of supported search/summary defaults, recent identity/order and usable cold-start/missing-enrichment behavior.
Verify opt-out, event deletion and profile reset, including delayed events/projections, without deleting the library or recreating prohibited behavior.
Complete resumable interest onboarding/skip and optional attributable ORCID suggestions without blocking normal service use.
Verify select/skip/stored state, interruption/revisit and prevention of redirect loops or unintended preference replacement.
Verify eligible ORCID suggestions and manual/skip alternatives for missing data, denied authorization and provider failure.
Complete topic following/configuration and recoverable consent-governed digest preparation/delivery/unsubscribe.
Verify owner-isolated follow/unfollow/configuration, duplicate prevention, durable changes and retained input boundary behavior.
Verify intended time/content windows, no-new-content, retry/crash/uncertain-send reconciliation and consent/unsubscribe recheck before delivery; prove sustainable public delivery.
Complete grounded questions/comparison/quotes across retained source scopes, including private/web distinctions, partial coverage and meaningful abstention.
Verify claims and literal quotations against accessible source/version/section, contradictions and insufficient-evidence behavior.
Verify authorized text/PDF attachments and supported web references, malformed/oversized/truncated/unsupported cases and untrusted-source isolation.
Verify structured output through extraction/model/context failures, explicit truncation and interrupted/duplicate requests with committed-input preservation.
Complete persisted sessions/messages and authoritative pending work; include the approved distinct durable-draft lifecycle without equating draft acknowledgement to submission.
Verify create/save/reopen, committed messages, pending/terminal progress, duplicate-turn prevention and late completion bound to the intended session/input.
Verify one/all-session deletion, cross-owner isolation, failed deletion and stale-link/late-event behavior under the approved pending-work/retention policy.
Complete topic/manuscript novelty, evidence/artifacts/discussion and recoverable jobs/cancellation; acknowledged manuscript drafts remain distinct from accepted analysis.
Verify both input modes, supported formats, source-associated artifacts/discussion and limitations; generated scores do not prove scientific novelty.
Verify duplicate submission, restart/reconnect, cancellation/completion races, final cancellation and owner-scoped artifact expiry without automatic export.
Complete per-owner Notion connection, current preview, explicit approval and reconciled external effect under verified free terms.
Verify owner connection/credential isolation, preview content/destination and revoked/invalid/disconnected recovery; read authorized novelty artifacts.
Bind approval to immutable artifact revision/content and destination; verify change/revocation, duplicate/timeout reconciliation and no effect from preview/cancel/expiry.
Complete truthful quota/plan inspection and authorized allocation/accounting; U1 supplies necessary initial enforcement and U3/U4 consume complete accounting contracts.
Verify owner allocation/usage visibility and auditable administrator grant/revoke with current MFA/authority; request tampering cannot assign entitlement.
Verify applicable protected actions at concurrent/retry/exhausted/reset boundaries, unknown usage, single effect and agreed refund/accounting rules; never activate spending.
Complete corpus ingestion/refresh/rebuild, canonical/version/dedup behavior, withdrawal and recoverable processing across authoritative inputs and derived representations.
Verify source eligibility, duplicate/reordered records, versions, dedup and stage/watermark completion under failure; fixture loading alone is not ingestion parity.
Verify withdrawal/license/access changes defeat stale projections/caches and give saved references explicit dispositions; resolve projection-writer responsibility.
Verify retry/dead-letter/reprocessing, partial batches, object/control/index interruption, rate limits and compatibility failure with repeatable non-corrupting recovery.
Complete capability-aware operations and cumulative application/platform integration; U1 provides essential journey feedback while each domain remains responsible for its own recovery.
Verify privacy-safe health/incident/resource/cost/grounding/reliability signals and authorized actions; distinguish observed, unknown and stale evidence.
Verify actual mounted capability readiness, missing stores/execution and disclosed degradation; process liveness and platform receipts are insufficient.
Reproduce controlled incidents, identify affected work, invoke authorized owner recovery and verify user/service state; telemetry failure cannot erase required evidence.
